name: FateIndustries Mash-Up Pack
author: FateIndustries
description: Adds my mash-up pack, comprising of the survival world me and my friends worked on, my texture pack and my 94-skin pack.
extended_description:
Adds my mash-up pack, comprising of the survival world me and my friends worked on, my texture pack and my 94-skin pack.
My mash-up pack also replaces the bow sound effect and the achievement icon for 'The Lie', as well as the music discs '13', 'cat' and 'where are we now'. Included is a guide on how to restore these files (.txt file located in root of game install directory).
